crossRefs.note: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and…
But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt…
If the spirit of the ruler rises up against you, don’t leave your place; for gentleness lays great offenses to rest.

translations.web: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”
translations.bsb: They answered a second time, “Let the king tell the dream to his servants, and we will give the interpretation.”
translations.kjv: They answered again and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will shew the interpretation
translations.asv: They answered the second time and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.
